name: Authorized user deletes a book from collection
description:
Precondition: user is created via API, token is generated, 1 book is added to collection.
UI: profile is opened via cookie injection, book is deleted via Trash icon
with confirmation in modal window.
Expected: book disappears from table on UI, and books array in GET /User becomes empty.

testStage.description:
Precondition: user is created via API, token is generated, 1 book is added to collection.
UI: profile is opened via cookie injection, book is deleted via Trash icon
with confirmation in modal window.
Expected: book disappears from table on UI, and books array in GET /User becomes empty.

steps.name: API: Create a test user qa_user_95fd8b53
API: Generate an access token with full details (token + expires) for qa_user_95fd8b53
UI: Set authentication cookies (userID, token, userName) for user eb20dd30-4c60-4cb9-8941-8a2cf04c3ead
API: Add book 9781449325862 to the collection of user eb20dd30-4c60-4cb9-8941-8a2cf04c3ead
Verify that profile page is opened
Verify that book with ISBN 9781449325862 is displayed in the table
Delete book with ISBN 9781449325862 via Trash icon with confirmation
Confirm deletion in the modal window
$(".modal-content") should be(visible (because The delete confirmation modal should be opened))
Accept the browser alert about the deleted book
$(".modal-content") should not be(visible (because The delete confirmation modal should be closed))
Verify that book with ISBN 9781449325862 is not in the table
API: Retrieve the user's book collection
